human_check_steps:
# Check: iOS key popup

1. Build and install the iOS app on an iPhone (`scripts/build-ios.sh`, or Xcode), then type in any app with Tatakikun.
2. Tap letters quickly: each shows a popup above the key (the letter large, its corner symbol small) for about 0.2 s.
3. Type fast with two thumbs: each new key's popup replaces the last one at once.
4. Hold g: the popup gives way to the & / ＆ choice as before; tap , and 。: they show their popup too.
label: implemented
title: iOS keyboard: pressing a letter or punctuation key shows it in a popup above the finger (as on Android), on screen at least 200 ms
without_human_check: Needs a look on a real iPhone: how the popup looks and feels while typing
